name: zotero-library-reconciler
description: Read-only cross-library reconciliation tools for Zotero 10.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/chrome/content && esbuild src/plugin/runtime.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=firefox115 --outfile=dist/chrome/content/runtime.js && cp src/plugin/bootstrap.js dist/bootstrap.js && cp src/plugin/*.xhtml dist/chrome/content/ && cp manifest.json chrome.manifest dist/
